title: AP2 Payment Mandate Credential
description: A source credential presented to a payment handler during tokenization when the AP2 Mandates extension is active. The handler verifies the payment mandate and, on success, issues a payment token in exchange. This credential type MUST NOT be used as a checkout credential: it is a tokenization input and never appears in a UCP request or response.

type.description: The credential type identifier for AP2 payment mandate credentials.

payment_mandate.description: SD-JWT+kb payment mandate proving user authorization of the funds transfer. Its structure is defined by the AP2 Protocol Specification.

checkout_hash.description: Base64url transaction digest the payment mandate is bound to, computed over the Checkout JWT as the AP2 Protocol Specification defines. Supplied so the handler can confirm it equals the mandate's transaction identifier without parsing AP2 claim structure, and record it against the token it issues. The value is opaque to the handler: it identifies a transaction without disclosing its terms. Neither the checkout nor the Checkout JWT is presented to a handler.
